links.surface: أبو يعقوب يوسف بن محمد بن زياد
أبو الحسن علي بن محمد بن سيار

notes: Two sayings in one report, the second with its own isnad (rule 11): «قام رجل إلى علي بن الحسين ... حدثني أبي، عن أخيه الحسن، عن أبيه أمير المؤمنين» is an anecdote inside the saying with its own chain; it is not written as a route here.
«وكانا من الشيعة الإمامية» is a descriptor and is left out; the blessing after the Hasan is removed.

notes: The first isnad ends at the Imam al-Hasan (narrator, after «عن»); «وكانا من الشيعة الإمامية» is the compiler's remark on the two men and is left out

Rule 11: the saying continues with a second isnad inside the matn («حدثني أبي، عن أخيه الحسن، عن أبيه أمير المؤمنين») and a second speaker (Ali b. al-Husayn) answering a man, so two sayings each carry an isnad. Flagged for a ruling; the second isnad is not read as a route here
